item.title: Maps
item.description:
If there is at least one gpx file in resources of given page, it will be automatically rendered at the bottom of the page, including basic legend with distance, time and possibility to download individual gpx files. If the gpx file contains waypoints, all will be rendered with appropriate icons (see next chapters).
